subject: Orchid Systems: Launch-week scheduling, host roster, and contingency plan
messages:
From: Claire Nguyen <claire.nguyen@orchidsystems.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Cc: Erin Park <erin.park@orchidsystems.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Sep 2028 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Launch week coordination (Week 0) — Orchard environment handoff

Hi Markus / Monica,

Thanks again — we're excited to get Week 0 lined up for Orchid's Redwood integration. We'd like to lock a 60–75 minute window for the handoff that covers: goals & success criteria, roles/owners, technical preflight, and the first-day runbook walkthrough.

Availability: our team is flexible Tue/Wed (next week) morning PT. Can you propose 2 windows we should block? Also please send the host roster (who from Redwood will be on the bridge) and the preferred bridge + backup plan (Zoom + fallback region/bridge).

Attendees on our side: myself (Claire, PM), Erin Park (SRE lead), Samir Patel (integration engineer). If others from your side should join (security/contact for the VPC work), please add them.

Thanks — Claire

--
Claire Nguyen
Program Manager, Orchid Systems
claire.nguyen@orchidsystems.com
+1 415-555-0182
From: markus_klein@redwood.com <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Claire Nguyen <claire.nguyen@orchidsystems.com>, monica_patel@redwood.com
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 18 Sep 2028 10:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Launch week coordination (Week 0) — Orchard environment handoff

Claire — great to meet you (virtually). Proposed windows (PT):

1) Tue Sep 26, 10:00–11:15 AM PT (preferred) — we can validate access and run the preflight checklist live.
2) Wed Sep 27, 08:30–09:45 AM PT — slightly earlier but gives us time to surface blockers before EOD.

Hosts from Redwood:
- Markus Klein (Implementation Lead) — primary bridge, runbook walkthrough
- Monica Patel (CS Ops) — onboarding ops, calendar + invites, runbook attachment owner
- Jonas Weber (SRE) — technical preflight and network/VPC checks

Bridge and contingency:
- Primary: Redwood Zoom bridge (zoom.us/j/987654321, passcode: Rw-ORCH)
- Fallback: Google Meet (meet.google.com/rw-orch-fallback) + AWS-hosted meeting bridge in us-west-2 if Zoom has issues.

Preflight items we'll cover on call: service account access, sample inference run, key rotation/credential handoff plan, and a short rollback/fallback plan. We'll attach a Week0 runbook draft and a small config snippet that your infra team can drop into staging.

I will tentatively hold the Tue slot and send a calendar invite once you confirm attendees.

Cheers,
Markus
Implementation Lead | Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com
From: Claire Nguyen <claire.nguyen@orchidsystems.com>

Date: Mon, 18 Sep 2028 13:07:00 -07:00

Markus — Tue Sep 26 10:00–11:15 AM PT works for us. Confirming attendees:
- Claire Nguyen (PM) — claire.nguyen@orchidsystems.com
- Erin Park (SRE lead) — erin.park@orchidsystems.com
- Samir Patel (integration) — samir.patel@orchidsystems.com
- Maya Liu (security reviewer) — maya.liu@orchidsystems.com (will join for the first 25 minutes)

Two quick asks:
1) Can you include a short agenda with timeboxes in the invite?
2) We'd appreciate a copy of the runbook and the redwood-config-snippet ahead of the call so our infra team can glance at it.

Thanks — Claire

Date: Tue, 19 Sep 2028 07:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Calendar invite + runbook (Orchid Week0)

Hi all — calendar invite sent for Tue Sep 26 10:00–11:15 AM PT. Agenda timeboxes included and a short contingency note. Invite links + assets below:

Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=orchid-week0-launch
Zoom bridge (primary): https://zoom.us/j/987654321 (passcode: Rw-ORCH)
Google Meet (fallback): https://meet.google.com/rw-orch-fallback
Runbook (preview): https://drive.google.com/file/d/Orchid_Week0_Runbook_v1.pdf
Config snippet: attached (redwood-config-snippet.txt) — small example for service account and KV cache settings for staging.

Agenda (60–75 min):
- 00:00–05:00 — Introductions & success criteria (Claire / Markus)
- 05:00–25:00 — Access & service account walkthrough (Jonas)
- 25:00–40:00 — Sample inference run + verification steps (Markus)
- 40:00–55:00 — Rollout & fallback plan (Monica)
- 55:00–65:00 — Q&A and immediate action items / next steps

Internal Redwood attendees on the invite: Markus Klein (Implementation Lead), Monica Patel (CS Ops), Jonas Weber (SRE)
Orchid attendees: Claire Nguyen, Erin Park, Samir Patel, Maya Liu (partial)

Attachments: Orchid_Week0_Runbook_v1.pdf, redwood-config-snippet.txt

If there are any network restrictions (e.g., company firewall that blocks Zoom), Erin, please share the outbound rules and we will route via the AWS-hosted bridge.

Thanks — Monica
Customer Success Operations | Redwood Inference
From: markus_klein@redwood.com <markus_klein@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 20 Sep 2028 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Calendar invite + runbook (Orchid Week0) — quick note

Quick reminder — looking forward to Tue's session. A couple of small asks before we meet:
1) Erin / Samir: if you can drop the output of a single sample inference (20 tokens) to the shared Drive folder it will save ~10 minutes on the call.
2) If Maya will join for the first 25 minutes for security sign-off, we will cover the credential rotation plan first so she can sign the doc early.

If anything changes, flag here and Monica will update the invite. See you Tuesday.

Best,
Markus
